name: Fujiwara no Yoshitaka
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 50); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 974.

poems.title: Death had no terrors, Life no joys
poems.author: Fujiwara no Yoshitaka
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 50
poems.text:
Death had no terrors, Life no joys,
Before I met with thee;
But now I fear, however long
My life may chance to be,
’Twill be too short for me!

poems.title: 50. 君がため 惜しからざりし 命さへ (Kimi ga tame oshikarazarishi inochi sae)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Yoshitaka
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後拾遺集
poems.text:
君がため 惜しからざりし 命さへ
長くもがなと 思ひけるかな
